== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ハイポ</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">ＩＴ－Ｏに配備する。自分の支配フェイズに捕虜と同じ位置にあれば、どちらかの効果を選ぶ。1：敵に、敵の手札について1つだけ、“はい”か“いいえ”で答えられる質問をする。敵は正直に答えるか、回答を拒否して1フォースを失う。2：フォース消耗を＋1する。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">バーヴォ6のような自白剤には、尋問への抵抗力を弱める効果がある。巨大な注射針を相手に向ける心理的効果は抜群で、尋問の効率も上がる。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Hypo.

'''Lore''' — Truth drugs such as Bavo Six weaken resistance to questioning. Pointing an enormous needle at the subject adds psychological pressure and makes the interrogation more effective.

'''Game text''' — Deploy on IT-O. If at the same location as a captive during your control phase, choose one effect. Ask your opponent one yes-or-no question about their hand. They must answer truthfully or refuse and lose 1 Force. Alternatively, increase the Force drain by 1.

The Japanese face says “at the same location as a captive” where the original English face says “present with a captive.” The Japanese subtype strip reads アイテム (Item). The original English strip reads Device.<ref>[[:File:ANewHope-D-hypo-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Hypo]].</ref>
